name: component
title: New Component
description: Creates a structural React component with an optional canonical grid and class atoms resolved before any files are written.

settings.name: title
settings.title: Title
settings.description: Optional display title for the generated React component; defaults to its name.

settings.name: description
settings.title: Description
settings.description: Optional description for the generated React component.

settings.name: indexed
settings.title: Include in Index
settings.description: Whether the generated item should appear in its project manifest.

settings.name: location
settings.title: Location
settings.description: Folder that will contain the component folder.

settings.name: save_as_text
settings.title: Save As Text
settings.description: Save the generated component as .txt for testing.

settings.name: grid
settings.title: Grid
settings.description: Optional canonical grid layout from the shared grid catalog. Use none or an empty value to skip.

settings.name: class_name
settings.title: Container Class
settings.description: Optional space-separated class atoms; absent classes are resolved before creation. Choose an empty value to skip.

settings.name: ensure_atoms
settings.title: Resolve Atom Dependencies
settings.description: Resolve supplied class atoms through the manifest or configured path before creating the component.

settings.name: atom_decisions
settings.title: Atom Decisions
settings.description: Per-class choices: create, kind and child tool options. All choices are resolved before any child tool writes.

settings.name: transmitting
settings.title: Transmitting
settings.description: Omit to use the signal template default.
